data.title: Rixos Hotels and Residences
data.about:
At Rixos Hotels and Residences by Nakheel, you can find your ideal sanctuary. Choose from an enthralling array of 1 to 3 bedroom apartments, 4 bedroom duplex apartments, beach houses, and villa residences. Embrace the Luxurious Lifestyle with Nakheel’s Modern Oasis, where every detail has been crafted to enhance your living experience.

This contemporary landscaped residential property, nestled behind the iconic Rixos Hotel, offers an array of desirable amenities designed specifically for people like you. Immerse yourself in the tranquillity of gorgeous pools, relax among lush green garden terraces, and revel in the splendour of a pristine beachfront, which offers a world of wellness activities and water sports right at your doorstep.

Enjoy the appeal of Rixos Dubai Islands Hotel & Residences, an attractive neighbourhood that warmly embraces families, creating priceless experiences for future generations. Tailor-made events for people of all ages seamlessly blend into each day, resulting in the remarkable life you’ve always imagined. Don’t pass up the opportunity to live in this paradise!

location_tile.title: Unrivalled living experience in the heart of Dubai’s enchanting islands
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Enjoy a location that combines the finest of both worlds, delivering an unrivalled living experience in the heart of Dubai’s enchanting islands. At Dubai Islands, you can live the ultimate island lifestyle, where diversified living meets vacation-inspired bliss. Enjoy a plethora of luxury resort offers, village centres brimming with services and entertainment, and premium wellness and sports venues that cater to your well-being. Enjoy the thrill of water sports on magnificent beaches and the serenity of bright green spaces for outdoor leisure hobbies.

  • 06 mins to Infinity Bridge
  • 18 mins to Dubai International Airport
  • 18 mins to Burjuman
  • 19 mins to Cruise Terminal
  • 25 mins to Dubai Mall
  • 26 mins to Downtown Dubai
